name: MiniMax API Platform
description: Serves MiniMax's M-series coding and agent models through Anthropic- and OpenAI-compatible APIs, plus video, speech, image and music generation, for developers building agents.

skills.name: Tool Use and Interleaved Thinking
skills.description: Runs M-series models that interleave reasoning with tool calls for multi-step agent workflows.

skills.name: Video Generation
skills.description: Creates videos from text, images or first and last frames with MiniMax H-series models.

skills.name: Text to Speech and Voice Cloning
skills.description: Synthesizes speech over HTTP or streaming WebSocket and clones or designs custom voices.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generates images from text or reference images.

skills.name: Music Generation
skills.description: Generates songs from a style prompt and lyrics, and writes or edits lyrics.
